difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a locally finitely presented morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S and a finite type quasi-coherent F on X with X equal to the support of F and F flat over Y, the morphism f is universally open (source lines 6539-6547). The proof reduces to schemes: choose surjective etale presentations V -> Y and U -> V x_Y X, observe that it suffices to prove the statement for U -> V with the pullback of F, and apply the corresponding scheme statement.
